# Seekgate — Design Notes

## Replication notes

- Preview returned 404; all design tokens extracted from screenshot
- Screenshot URL: https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/colorlib-search-form-9.jpg

## Key design decisions

- Centered white card on light blue-gray (#dce9ef) background
- Main search input with magnifying glass icon, teal divider below
- Advanced search section with 2x3 grid of filter dropdowns
- Result count in teal, RESET text button, SEARCH teal button
- Roboto font from Google Fonts
- Teal accent color #5fb8c2 for buttons, results, and divider
